title: QUALITY SPORT Topsport Italia
description: topsportitalia.it qualitysport.com Topsport Italia (founded 1972, Savigliano, Piedmont) and Quality Sport Italia S.r.l. (registered 2009, same address) are two sides of one B2B sports-equipment operator in Italy, run today by director Dario Valsania after being spun out of the larger Bongiovanni Sport group. Topsport designs and installs sports facilities "turnkey" — courts, suspended ceilings, partitions, bleachers and lighting — while Quality Sport sells and services fitness machines, gymnastics gear and accessories to sports schools, associations and public bodies via its qualitysport.com platform. Their model is full-service: consulting, equipment selection, installation, training and after-sales, backed by their own warehouse in Savigliano. The two brands share one multilingual e-commerce platform (6 languages) and a combined catalog. They are a solid mid-sized niche player with 50+ years of heritage
